statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail 22 reflects unresolved Gulf escalation and Friday's rates repricing while NQ is closed and live persistent price-path evidence is unavailable.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold during the closure; Sunday futures reopening is the next live checkpoint for gap persistence, retracement quality and cross-asset confirmation.
headline: Weekend Gulf risk remains at WATCH as Sunday Nasdaq futures reopening approaches
body: NQ is closed. No newer verified escalation materially changes the weekend setup. Gulf vessel conflict, constrained energy flows and Friday's payroll-driven yield rise keep Stress extreme; absent live persistence evidence keeps Tail at 22.

lookbackSummary: Published lookback: Tail was 18 from 04:00-08:00 UTC Saturday, 24 from 09:00 UTC Saturday-01:00 UTC Sunday after vessel escalation, then 23 at 02:00-03:00 UTC Sunday.
outlookSummary: With stable headlines Tail can ease while NQ is closed, then risk concentrates around the 22:00 UTC Sunday Globex reopening. Elevated Tail is conditional on a directional gap with shallow or failed retracements and aligned cross-asset pressure. Monday Nasdaq cash trading is closed for Labor Day.
